title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A novel set in the Roaring Twenties, The Great Gatsby explores themes of decadence, love, and the American Dream.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A gripping novel that tackles racial injustice and the loss of innocence in the American South.

author: George Orwell
description: A totalitarian regime uses surveillance, censorship, and propaganda to control citizens in Orwell's chilling portrayal of a dystopian future.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A witty exploration of class, marriage, and morality, centered around the strong-willed Elizabeth Bennet.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: The epic tale of Captain Ahab's obsessive quest to hunt down the elusive white whale, Moby-Dick.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
description: A coming-of-age story about a disillusioned teenager, Holden Caulfield, as he navigates the challenges of adolescence.

title: War and Peace
author: Leo Tolstoy
description: A sweeping epic set against the backdrop of Napoleonic Wars, this novel explores love, family, and the impact of war on society.

title: The Odyssey
author: Homer
description: The legendary Greek epic that follows Odysseus' perilous journey home from the Trojan War.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
description: A futuristic society prioritizing happiness through genetic engineering, mind control, and consumerism.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: The prelude to The Lord of the Rings, Bilbo Baggins embarks on an adventure to reclaim stolen treasure from a dragon.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A troubled student, Raskolnikov, grapples with guilt after committing a murder, exploring themes of morality, punishment, and redemption.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: The life and emotional journey of the orphaned Jane Eyre, from her difficult childhood to her complex relationship with Mr. Rochester.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: Dorian Gray, a handsome young man, remains eternally youthful while his portrait ages, reflecting his immoral actions.

title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
description: In a future where books are banned, fireman Guy Montag struggles with his role in a society that burns knowledge.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: Victor Frankenstein's creation of a monster leads to tragedy, exploring themes of ambition, responsibility, and human nature.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A young Andalusian shepherd named Santiago embarks on a journey to find a hidden treasure, learning valuable life lessons along the way.

title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy
description: A father and son journey through a desolate, post-apocalyptic world, struggling to survive and maintain their humanity.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
author: Margaret Atwood
description: In a theocratic society where women are subjugated, Offred struggles to reclaim her autonomy and fight against oppression.

title: The Sun Also Rises
author: Ernest Hemingway
description: A group of expatriates living in post-World War I Europe seek meaning in a world of loss and disillusionment.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Frodo Baggins and a fellowship of companions set out to destroy the One Ring and thwart the evil Sauron.

title: The Stranger
author: Albert Camus
description: A Frenchman, Meursault, lives an emotionally detached life, and his indifferent reaction to a crime leads to an existential confrontation.

title: Slaughterhouse-Five
author: Kurt Vonnegut
description: Billy Pilgrim becomes 'unstuck in time' and experiences the bombing of Dresden during World War II in this anti-war classic.

title: Catch-22
author: Joseph Heller
description: A darkly comic novel about a U.S. bomber squadron in World War II, where soldiers try to survive in an absurd, contradictory military system.
